```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set the style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a count plot for survival based on class and sex
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
ax = sns.countplot(data=data, x='class', hue='survived', palette='Set2')

# Add labels and title
ax.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=12)
ax.set_title('Survival Count by Passenger Class and Sex', fontsize=15)

# Modify the legend
handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
labels = ['Not Survived', 'Survived']
ax.legend(handles=handles, labels=labels, title='Survival')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
